headline: SEA @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 3.90 at BAL 4.13, with a projected total of 8.04. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: SEA moved -0.07 runs while BAL moved +0.92, changing the projected margin by -0.99 runs. The projected total climbed +0.85, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brandon Young has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Pete Alonso, Cole Young, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luke Raley, Samuel Basallo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
